items.title: Operational Truth: Why Trustworthy AI Cannot Be Benchmarked
items.summary: Presented by Shahid Shah, Founder of Intellectual Frontiers LLC, at the IEEE Baltimore Technical Colloquium, University of Maryland, Baltimore County, on November 7, 2026, in the AI Meets Physical Reality track.Trustworthy AI requires evidence from operation, not just benchmark scores. This presentation connects NIST AI RMF and TEVV, ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act, FDA guidance, ISO 21448 and NERC to practical post-deployment monitoring, human oversight and measurable evidence of safe use.Updated presentation: 16 slides plus one backup slide.
